data.title: Talent Ops Specialist
data.description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for consumer brands. One agent that owns the entire customer journey, running on a shared intelligence layer no point tool can replicate.

Consumer brands run ten or more disconnected tools to manage their customers. We collapse that stack into a single agent. It started with support, the hardest surface a brand has, and it expands from there: Shopping Agent, Social Agent, Siena working alongside a brand's own operators. One agent across every surface, with shared memory, shared context, and shared tools.

Hundreds of brands already run real customer volume on Siena in production. This is built, working, and growing, and we are racing to build what comes next.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to own real problems rather than close tickets, keep reading.

The Role
Hiring at Siena is moving fast, and it's about to move faster. So we’re looking for the next athlete to join our Talent Ops team.

You'll own the candidate's first experience of Siena end to end: triage, first screen, feedback, follow-through. You're accountable for the quality and experience of everyone who makes it through your part of the process, as well as the experience of the ones who don't.

Recruiting at Siena is owned, not handed off. You'll stay close to the candidate, close to the Talent Ops Manager, and close to the tools that run the work, so nothing gets lost between hand-offs.

What you'll own

  • Inbound triage and first-round screens across our highest-volume and highest-stakes roles

  • Every candidate's answer, on time. This is the standard the function is built around.

  • Scheduling and logistics across a growing slate of live roles

  • Ashby, kept immaculate. Pipelines, notes, statuses, always current. If it's not clean in Ashby, it didn't happen.

  • AI in your workflow. Claude and tools like it aren't optional; you use them to run the work, not just draft an email

  • Occasional sourcing support when volume calls for it. Outbound stays with the Talent Ops Manager, but you'll pitch in when the moment needs it

What you bring

  • Agency background, whether that meant volume at pace or a handful of searches done with real precision

  • You treat every candidate like a relationship, not a transaction - including the ones who don't move forward.

  • Time at a boutique agency, or a startup at Series A or earlier. You've worked without a playbook and you're comfortable building one

  • Comfortable building real workflows with Claude or similar. This isn't optional here, it's how the job gets done.

This role is not for you if

  • You want a fully scoped queue and clear instructions before you'll act. This role runs on judgment, not a checklist.

  • You think candidate feedback is optional once someone's a no. Here, it's the standard the whole function is built around.

  • You're waiting for the next direction before you'll take real ownership. The ownership is yours, just check on alignment

  • You want to skip the AI tooling and do things the old way because it's familiar. That's not on the table here.

  • You're looking for a pure headhunting or closing role. This is the operational and candidate-experience layer, and it's just as demanding.

  • You need a manager checking your work daily to feel confident it's right. You'll be trusted to run this, and expected to flag it yourself when something's off.

The deal

Six-month fixed-term contract, with potential to transition to a permanent role at the end of the term based on performance and business need

Why Siena?

  • Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

  • Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

  • A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

  • A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

  • Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

  • Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

  • AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.


Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Compensation: $60K – $80K • (pro-rated for the 6-month term), depending on experience

  • • $60K – $80K • (pro-rated for the 6-month term), depending on experience

data.title: AML Team Leader
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As an AML Team Leader, you will play a key role in leading a dynamic and motivated team focused on ensuring adherence to Anti-Money Laundering processes. You will work closely with governance, compliance, operations and other stakeholders to maintain high standards in quality assurance, training and operational excellence.

You will contribute to enhancing operational efficiency by managing quality scorecards, refining procedures on Confluence, and driving alignment through governance meetings. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and is eager to make a meaningful impact in combating financial crime.


YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Oversee team operations by managing staff schedules, addressing absences, and ensuring adequate coverage to maintain productivity and team morale.

  • Act as a reliable point of reference, providing expert guidance and promptly addressing team queries or escalations.

  • Managing ramp-up plans, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and addressing QA queries effectively.

  • Assigning and following up on updates or creation of internal operational procedures.

  • Managing quality scorecards and training material.

  • Assuring the quality and effectiveness of training programs to support team readiness and adherence.

  • Tracking and following up on tasks to ensure timely resolution.

  • Preparing reports and conducting investigations in relation to training and quality.

  • Leading or contributing to cross-functional projects that enhance AML best practices.


OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:

  • Strong leadership and team management capabilities, including performance reviews and development planning.

  • Ability to work independently and excellent organisational and time-management skills for handling diverse responsibilities.

  • Proficiency in using tools like Confluence and familiarity with QA methodologies.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with compliance, governance, MLROs, operations and cross-functional teams..

  • Strong communication skills and an ability to provide accurate and relevant information to stakeholders

  • A creative mindset with the ability to think outside the box and propose innovative ideas and see those ideas through to completion.

  • Capable of collaborating with other departments to resolve complex queries and grow internal relationships.

  • Ability to meet deadlines on a day-to-day basis and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work well with others and be an ambitious team player.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and Google Apps.


WHO WE ARE

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide.

BENEFITS

  • Hybrid working - 3 days per week at the office, with flexibility for 2 days at home

  • Workation – Take your job on an adventure with our Workation benefit for up to 4 weeks per year (T&Cs apply).

  • Plenty of time to recharge – 28 days of paid leave, plus all public and bank holidays in England.

  • Invest in your future – We match pension contributions up to 6%.

  • Comprehensive healthcare – BUPA coverage, including pre-existing conditions, plus a cashback plan for dental, optical, and other treatments.

  • Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply).

  • A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, free onsite parking, complimentary snacks and drinks, Monday breakfasts, and Friday lunches.

  • A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun.

  • Support for growing families – Up to 6 months of full pay for maternity leave.

  • Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts.

  • And there’s more… We’ll share even more perks related to your role when you chat with our Talent Acquisition team!

 

JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!

As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

data.title: Sports Trader
data.description:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Title: Sports Trader

Team: Trading

Location: Gibraltar, on-site

We’re looking for an experienced Sports / Risk Trader who knows there’s a lot more to trading than moving a price and watching the liability screen.

You’ll join Midnite’s growing trading team, helping us manage risk across a wide range of sports. That means profiling customers, managing events and limits, pricing markets and making good calls when the action starts coming in.

You’ll need strong sporting knowledge, sound judgement and at least three years’ experience in a sports trading or risk role. We’re growing quickly, so we’re after someone who knows their stuff but still wants to learn, improve and help us do things better.

Hours of work: Monday - Sunday (8am-12pm) 5/7 days.

You will:

  • Profile customers and manage risk based on betting behaviour.

  • Manage sporting events from a risk perspective, including liabilities and limits.

  • Set and manage prices across a range of sports.

  • Price specials and unique betting markets.

  • Handle trading-related customer queries accurately and efficiently.

  • Work closely with our trading suppliers to keep things running as they should.

  • Collaborate with the wider team to plan and promote trading products.

  • Get stuck into all aspects of trading operations as we continue to grow.

The next Midniter:

  • Will have at least 3 years’ experience working as a Sports / Risk Trader, including profiling customers.

  • Will have experience managing sporting events from a risk perspective.

  • Will have experience managing limits on events.

  • Will have experience managing prices across a variety of sports.

  • Will have deep sporting knowledge. Not just football and whatever happens to be on Sky Sports Main Event.

  • Will be comfortable making good trading decisions when things are moving quickly.

  • Will want to help build a sportsbook that does things differently.

💰Winnings

  • Join us at an exciting stage as we establish our Gibraltar office. We're investing in a great local employee experience and will continue to expand our benefits package as we grow.

  • Additional annual leave based on tenure. Get two extra days after three years at Midnite, another three after five years, and one more after eight - taking your total annual leave to 34 days

  • Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

At Midnite, we’re committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.

We aim to provide an inclusive and supportive interview experience for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in advance so we can ensure you feel comfortable and set up for success.

data.description:
About Ema

Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Role: Senior Technical Support Specialist (Enterprise Agentic AI)

Company: Ema Unlimited Inc.
Location: London
Employment Type: Full-time/Remote

 
 

1. About Ema (Why Ema)

Ema is building the world’s first Universal AI Employee — a production-grade agentic AI platform that automates real enterprise workflows across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations.

Ema’s customers do not run demos. They replace mission-critical, manual business processes with agentic AI systems that operate across multiple SaaS tools, APIs, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

In this world, support is not reactive. Support is production reliability, trust preservation, and system learning. At Ema, Senior Technical Support Specialists are operators of live AI systems, not ticket handlers.

 

2. Role Overview

The Senior Support Engineer owns the health, reliability, and trustworthiness of Ema’s deployed agentic AI systems in production. This role sits at the intersection of:

  • AI behavior

  • Workflow orchestration

  • Enterprise integrations

  • Customer trust

  • Engineering feedback loops

This is: ❌ Not L1 / call-center support, ❌ Not a “just escalate to engineering” role, ❌ Not reactive firefighting only

This is: A senior technical escalation role, A production debugging and RCA role, A partner to Engineering, Product, and Implementation, A role with real authority during incidents

Impact at Ema

  • You are the last line of defense between a production issue and customer trust erosion

  • You prevent small failures from turning into account-level crises

  • You ensure learnings from incidents improve the product and delivery systemically

Impact on Customers

  • Customers trust Ema because issues are handled competently and transparently

  • AI failures are explained, mitigated, and prevented — not hand-waved

  • Production stability improves over time, not degrades

Impact on Your Career

  • You gain rare experience operating agentic AI systems in production

  • Debugging issues spanning:

    • AI behavior (false positives / negatives)

    • Workflow logic

    • Integrations (HRIS, ITSM, IAM, Finance)

    • Data quality

    • Platform configuration

  • Handling Sev-1 / Sev-2 customer specific incidents calmly under customer pressure

5.1 Production Issue Ownership

5.2 Debugging, Diagnosis & Sev 1/2 Issue Resolution

  • Debug agentic workflows end-to-end

  • Trace failures across agents, tools, integrations, and humans-in-the-loop

  • Identify whether issues are caused by:

    • Model behavior

    • Workflow orchestration

    • Integration constraints

    • Customer configuration

If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About the Role:

DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps..

What You'll Own:

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

  • Collaborate with Content, Creative, and Regional Marketing teams to produce and localize campaign assets.

  • Maintain a global campaign calendar and asset library, ensuring brand consistency, messaging alignment, and timely deployment across all touchpoints, and coordinate with owners of other persona tracks (e.g., Product/Eng/Dev) so the portfolio campaign reads as one coherent motion.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team to design and execute ABM programs, building tailored campaign strategies, messaging, and content for prioritized accounts and account tiers.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing and RevOps to feed account engagement, pipeline influence, and conversion data back into ABM targeting and strategy decisions.

  • Continuously refine account segmentation and messaging based on engagement signals, win/loss insights, and sales feedback.

.Measurement & Optimization

  • Drive measurable impact on awareness, adoption, and pipeline; setting and tracking KPIs such as lead quality, conversion rates, account engagement, and ROI.

  • Collaborate with Performance Marketers to initiate data-driven optimization and A/B testing across campaign channels and ABM plays to continuously improve performance.

  • Leverage insights and competitive intelligence to inform campaign strategy, refine positioning, and identify new opportunities in the AI translation market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Foster cross-functional collaboration and campaign excellence, sharing learnings, best practices, and post-mortem analyses to continually improve performance and scalability.

  • Serve as the campaigns subject matter expert, representing campaign and ABM performance in relevant leadership and planning forums.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or ABM roles.

  • Proven track record of managing complex, multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution.

  • Understanding account-based marketing programs, including account tiering, personalized content, and multi-touch orchestration alongside Sales.

  • Demonstrated success driving pipeline generation and revenue growth through integrated and account-based campaigns.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Data-driven decision-making and proficiency in campaign analytics, attribution, and performance optimization.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management, particularly with Sales and SDR teams.

  • AI literacy, including familiarity with GenAI tools for campaign planning, content creation, and execution.

  • Preferred: previous experience in high-growth SaaS companies (Series B–IPO stage).

  • Preferred: experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) in addition to core marketing tech.

Technical Requirements - nice to have:

  • Marketing Automation: HubSpot

  • CRM: Salesforce (or equivalent)

  • ABM Platform: 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar (preferred)

  • Project Management: Asana, Jira, or similar tools

  • Content Management: Contentful or comparable CMS/DAM platforms

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, but the systems they rely on for payments are slow, manual and were never built for them. Apron is fixing that. We digitise and simplify how SMBs manage cash flow: capturing invoices, issuing expense cards, and moving money in one place.

Founded in 2021, we've grown to ~100 people across the UK, Germany, Spain and raised $50M, backed by Index Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Zinal Grow and Tony Fadell.

Our next phase of growth isn’t incremental. We’re building a category-defining, global fintech business with a clear path to significant revenue scale and international expansion. This phase requires not just a great product but a world-class engineering team.


Our engineering culture

  • We build with the customer in mind. Top-tier technology, in service of making their lives genuinely easier.

  • We own our work. We plan, break it down, and ship it end to end.

  • We embrace the complexity of finance. Money means intricate business logic and real edge cases. Precision matters here.

  • We write code we're proud of. Fast doesn't mean sloppy, we build for the long term.

  • We use AI where it helps. The best tools available, used to build better products faster.

What you’ll own

We're hiring more than one engineer for different teams, this means:

  • You’ll build and scale the backend powering our core product lines like Bill Pay or Apron Card and the systems our business depends on like fraud detection.

  • You'll work cross-functionally with Frontend Engineers, Product Managers and Product Designers to ship new features from discovery through to production.

  • You’ll design financial integrations where security and speed both matter.

  • You’ll share your experience with others, driving innovation, proactively suggesting improvements and raising the bar for the team.

What you’ll need

  • 8+ years of continuous experience as a backend engineer.

  • Previous in-house experience working in a product-led + fast-paced environment (startup or Tech company).

  • Proficient in JVM-based languages, ideally Kotlin, for server-side development.

Life at TodayTix Group
We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.

About the Role: 

Powered by TodayTix (PxT) is TodayTix Group's enterprise ticketing and e-commerce division — the technology and tools that help the world's leading cultural organisations, attractions, and live events power their box office and drive online sales. We work with some of the most exciting venues, producers, and event organisers on the planet, and we're building the platform that helps them thrive.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the PxT team — someone who thrives on data, moves fast, and is obsessed with identifying friction and building products that meaningfully improve how people discover, buy, and experience live events.

You'll own product discovery and delivery for a key area of our platform, working directly with producers and event organisers to understand their needs, shape solutions, and bring them to life alongside world-class engineering and design teams.

You instinctively reach for AI to think, prototype, validate ideas, and accelerate learning. You'll often start with ambiguity rather than requirements and enjoy identifying opportunities, forming hypotheses, and turning ideas into action.

This role sits at the intersection of user experience and business strategy.   • Product direction established → Within the first 60–90 days, you've developed a strong understanding of your product area and helped shape a roadmap informed by customer insight, business priorities, and platform goals.

  • Customer obsession in practice → Ongoing discovery is embedded in your workflow, with evidence that customer insights directly influence prioritisation and product decisions.

  • Experimentation velocity → Ideas move quickly from concept to learning through prototypes, pilots, and releases.

  • Features shipped with measurable impact → Platform initiatives launched with measurable outcomes tied to adoption, conversion, GMV, operational efficiency, retention, or partner satisfaction.

  • Commercial contribution → Your work contributes meaningfully to partner and business outcomes through stronger engagement, increased value, or improved performance metrics.

  • AI-native execution → AI is embedded throughout your workflow — helping you synthesise research, generate prototypes, validate assumptions, and accelerate delivery.

  • Team impact → You're contributing to how great product work gets done at TodayTix Group — not just within your own area, through mentorship, management, and raising the bar across the team.


    • What You'll Do:

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design teams to deliver platform features that solve real customer problems.

  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Contribute to roadmap development and prioritisation across the broader PxT platform.

  • Manage complex cross-functional initiatives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned.

  • Demonstrated builder mindset — whether through launching products, founding something, side projects, experimentation, or creating new processes from scratch.

  • Strong experience owning product initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Strong communication and strategic thinking skills — able to articulate ideas, navigate tradeoffs, and influence decisions.

  • Experience in live events, hospitality, marketplace, or premium consumer experiences is a plus.

  • Fluency with AI tools as part of your daily workflow — using them habitually to accelerate research, prototyping, decision-making, and execution.

  • Comfort in fast-paced, cross-functional environments — you know how to collaborate across design, engineering, and commercial teams.

  • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, or marketing technology is a plus.

  • Experience with sports ticketing, a plus.

We foster an environment of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, offering unparalleled opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

We're looking for a generalist operator to join the team — someone with sharp judgment, a bias to action, and the instinct to dig into a problem, figure out what to measure, and ship a solution without waiting for instructions. You'll work across e-commerce, customer experience, data, and operations — owning problem spaces end-to-end from identification through delivery and measurement.

This isn't a role where you sit in a lane. You'll move between strategy, analysis, customer insight, and hands-on building depending on what the problem requires — and you like it that way. You might come from analytics, product management, operations, or something else entirely. Over time, the role may specialise based on your strengths and where the business needs you.

Example: you notice our cancellation policy is generating avoidable refund volume, analyse the alternatives and their impact, recommend a change, and lead the implementation through to measurement.

  • Clarity that moves people → When you frame a problem, write a recommendation, or present a post-launch read, people act on it. Engineers and operators are faster because you made the next steps obvious.

  • Expanding scope → Over time, you own more because you've earned trust through execution. Harder problems come your way because the earlier ones are handled.

  • Own problem spaces across e-commerce, CX, and operations end-to-end — define success criteria, build dashboards, run analysis, and present actionable reads to leadership.

  • Dig into customer and operational data to find the problems worth solving, then partner with product and engineering to solve them.

  • Talk to customers, operators, and support agents to build qualitative context around quantitative signals.

  • Build prototypes, dashboards, automations, and analyses using whatever tools fit — SQL, spreadsheets, AI tools, lightweight apps. You don't wait for someone else to build it.

  • Write things down: frame problems, define ownership, and make next steps obvious so engineers and operators can move faster.

About the Role: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join TodayTix Group and own how we scale our data platform — the backbone connecting product, growth, finance, and CX to a single source of truth, plus increasingly the substrate AI tooling across the company queries directly. You'll lead the team that owns the project end-to-end — staging, intermediates, and marts — plus the CI/CD pipeline and Snowflake platform underneath it.

This is a technical leadership role, not a heads-down modelling one — most of your time goes to architecture, review, technical strategy, and cross-functional leadership, with hands-on modelling a deliberate minority. You lead by setting direction, raising the team's bar, and owning delivery, quality, and stakeholder trust across a high-demand roadmap.

The foundation is built — your job is what gets built on top of it as the org scales. TTG is expanding as part of MARI, bringing new portfolio companies' event and ticketing data onto the platform; PxT (our partner-facing product) is growing its surface area; and the business keeps adding markets and brands. You'll design how the platform absorbs that growth — new sources, new consumers, higher stakes — without the architecture buckling.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, measure your impact by the team's, not just your own, and care as much about business impact as technical craft, we'd love to hear from you — especially if, like the rest of the team, you reach for AI by default.

Please note: This full-time position and qualified candidates must be based in the Greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.


What Success Looks Like:

  • The platform scales, it doesn't strain → New portfolio events, new surfaces, and new markets onboard onto the existing staging/intermediates/marts pattern without one-off hacks or a rebuild.

  • Data people trust by default → Certified marts stay accurate and documented as volume and source count grow; breaking changes get caught by CI and dbt tests, not discovered by a stakeholder in a dashboard.

  • A faster, more autonomous team → Engineers ship models confidently without you reviewing every line; your reports are visibly levelling up.

  • Architecture that holds → Your design decisions — dynamic tables vs. incremental models, how a new portfolio company's data enters the model, orchestration choices — hold up as sources and consumers multiply, and design flaws get caught in review, not production.

  • Trust through ownership → Stakeholders across product, growth, finance, and CX bring you problems, not tickets, because you communicate early and their reporting hasn't broken under them.


    • What You'll Do:

  • Own the data platform end-to-end — the dbt project (staging → intermediates → marts), CI/CD, and the Snowflake infrastructure it runs on.

  • Design and lead the onboarding of new data sources onto the platform as TTG scales, so growth doesn't mean architectural debt.

  • Partner with data consumers — product, growth, finance, CX, and incoming portfolio teams — to model new sources cleanly rather than bolt them on under deadline pressure.

  • Run intake and prioritisation across a high-demand roadmap where reporting, growth analytics, and AI-tooling initiatives compete for the same team's time — sequence against business objectives, and say no well.

  • Protect data quality systematically — dbt tests, contract-enforced schemas, and CI that catches breaking changes before they reach a dashboard or an AI agent.

  • Set technical direction for the warehouse and give the kind of code review that makes data engineers better — spotting model design flaws before they ship.

  • Lead and grow the team — 1:1s, feedback, and career development.

  • Build the factory, not just the models: keep pushing AI into how the team works, and support the org's growing use of AI agents as direct consumers of the warehouse you build.


    • We're Looking for Someone With:

  • A track record of leading engineers. 8+ years in data engineering (or software engineering with a heavy data bent), including leading a team — formally or informally — and growing the engineers around you. This is the core of the role.

  • Deep SQL and dbt expertise. You've built and scaled a dbt project in production — models, tests, macros, contracts — and reason about warehouse cost and performance, not just correctness.

  • Cloud data warehouse depth. Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable MPP warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery).

  • Experience scaling a data platform through growth — onboarding new business units, acquisitions, or data sources onto an existing model without rearchitecting from scratch. (M&A / multi-entity data integration experience is directly relevant given the evolving company structure.)

  • Full-stack data platform judgement. Comfortable across ingestion (CDC/replication from operational databases, event pipelines), transformation (dbt), and consumption (BI tools, reverse ETL, AI/agent access) — even where you're not the one writing every layer.

  • Strong architecture and code review. You set technical direction through sound data-model design and give review that makes engineers better.

  • Stakeholder management. You partner with product, finance, growth, and CX — translating messy source data into models people trust, and setting expectations as priorities shift.

  • A product and business mindset. You measure success by the decisions your data enabled, not rows modelled.

  • AI fluency. You already reach for AI to write and review data models, and you're comfortable with AI agents as first-class consumers of the warehouse you build.

  • Experience with CDC / replication tools feeding a warehouse from an operational database (MySQL, Postgres)

  • Experience with Looker/LookML or another BI semantic layer.

  • Experience in e-commerce, ticketing, or a marketplace business with high-cardinality partner/catalogue data.

About the Role: 

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Director of CRM and Lifecycle Marketing to own our CRM program, every email, push, and SMS we send to millions of theatre and event-goers, and to lead the team that runs it. CRM is how we turn interest into action across a customer's life with us: getting new customers to their first show, keeping our best customers coming back, and winning back the ones who've drifted. You'll own that messaging end to end and be the person the company trusts on anything CRM.

Our CRM already drives a large share of our business. Now we want to make it one of the smartest, most automated programs out there. We're building toward a Next Best Action model where automation and AI decide the right message, moment, and channel for each customer, at scale. We want someone genuinely energized by that: who sees automation and AI as the core of how a modern CRM program runs, and who will keep pushing what's possible, including piloting new channels and surfaces, like WhatsApp.

This is a role for someone who thrives on full end-to-end ownership. You'll set the strategy, bring the ideas, and run the program without waiting to be told what to do.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are energized by data, automation, and building programs that scale, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note: This is a full-time role and qualified candidates must be based in the greater New York City or London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, while also offering flexibility for employees to choose where they work for the rest of the week.


What Success Looks Like:

  • Repeat purchase and retention climb among addressable customers.

  • More new customers make a first and second purchase, and make it sooner, as onboarding messaging turns a trial into a habit.

  • Revenue from CRM channels grows as a share of total and is trusted as incremental, not just attributed.

  • A Next Best Action model is live and increasingly automated. The model is choosing the right message, moment, and channel for messages.

  • You've become the company's clear owner of CRM: leadership sets the goals, and the strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day calls are yours.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the CRM program end to end - set the strategy and roadmap for every email, push, and SMS, generate the ideas that move it forward, and be the person the company trusts to make the call.

  • Make AI and automation core - push the program from batch campaigns to an automated, AI-driven Next Best Action model that picks the right message, moment, and channel for each customer.

  • Lead full-lifecycle messaging - from user onboarding through repeat, winback, and loyalty, with repeat purchase as the core goal.

  • Explore new channels and surfaces - pilot opportunities like WhatsApp and in-app messaging in partnership with product, and scale the ones that work.

  • Lead and develop the team - coach the CRM team, prioritize sharply, and raise the bar on both execution and analysis.

  • Make CRM provably incremental - establish holdout testing and reporting so the program’s revenue impact is measurable.

data.description:
Raft is building the enterprise AI platform for supply chain - the industry that literally keeps the world moving.

We’ve built deep credibility in the supply chain sector, partnering with more than 60 global leaders to eliminate manual processes, unify fragmented systems, and unlock intelligence at scale. Along the way, we’ve raised $45M from Bessemer Venture Partners and Eight Roads to accelerate this mission.

With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • The problem is real, and the scale is global. The supply chain industry moves $19 trillion of goods a year. We're building the AI workforce that makes it run smarter. Your work will matter.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

data.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Why this role exists?

Allica is expanding internationally, establishing a regulated entity in its first international market and deploying the proprietary technology platform there.

The platform model is deliberately repeatable, so that further markets can be added if and when the opportunity arises. The purpose of this role is to design and implement a repeatable international platform model, prove it in the first market, and enable each local entity to operate its own identity and local access services within centrally governed technology, security and identity standards.

The role owns the international Azure platform end to end, from design and build through ongoing run. Identity is delivered on a build-and-hand-over basis: the role designs and implements each entity's Entra environment, then transitions day-to-day operation to the local team, remaining involved for enhancement rather than implementation. Both sit within a governance model where technical controls are defined centrally by Allica's UK platform and security functions, and each international entity operates as a consumer of those controls with local attestation.

Accountabilities

Multi-market platform foundations, delivered as code

  • Design and build a parameterised Azure landing zone that can be instantiated per market, covering subscription and management group topology, networking, connectivity, policy assignment, and baseline observability.

  • Deliver the entire estate through Infrastructure as Code with peer review, automated policy compliance checks, and no manual configuration changes. The landing zone is a product, not a project.

  • Make market-specific variation explicit and narrow — a small, documented set of local deltas over a common baseline, rather than a fork.

    Identity and access across multiple entities

  • Work with central Technology, Identity and Security teams to design and implement a repeatable Entra operating model for international entities, including tenant structure, directory topology, privileged-access patterns, joiner–mover– leaver processes and conditional-access baselines.

  • Lead the technical onboarding and initial implementation of each entity’s Entra environment in line with centrally approved architecture and control standards.

  • Ensure each local entity has the capability, documentation, access model, runbooks and evidence processes required to operate its own Entra tenant dayto-day.

  • Establish a clear handover and assurance model: local entity teams operate workforce identity and local access administration; central teams own the architectural standards and control baseline; the International Platform team leads implementation and, following handover, supports oversight and enhancement rather than day-to-day operation.

  • Work with central identity owners on cross-entity access and material design changes. Local regulatory deltas and exceptions must be documented, evidenced and approved through the central governance process.

Regulatory and control assurance

  • Operate the "central controls, local attestation" model: implement Allica's centrally-defined control set in each market, maintain the evidence that demonstrates it, and manage the thin layer of genuine local regulatory delta.

  • Produce and maintain a local-delta attestation template that scales to further markets.

  • Ensure the platform meets DORA and operational resilience obligations — ICT risk management, incident classification and reporting, resilience testing, and third-party ICT arrangements.

Running the platform

  • Own service availability and performance for the international platform, including on-call arrangements, incident management, SLOs, capacity, and change management.

  • Define an operating model that is sustainable for a small team across time zones, and that scales as markets are added rather than multiplying headcount linearly.

  • Feed run experience back into the landing zone templates so each subsequent market starts from a better baseline.

Leading the team

  • Recruit, lead, and develop a small, senior engineering team. Set the technical bar and be an active participant in the work.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Substantial hands-on Azure architecture experience at scale, including landing zone design, management group and subscription topology, networking, and Azure Policy

  • .Deep, practical Infrastructure as Code capability (Terraform) including module design for reuse, and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure.

  • Demonstrable experience designing and operating Microsoft Entra ID in a multientity or multi-tenant context: tenancy models, conditional access, privileged identity management, and identity lifecycle automation.

  • Delivery within a regulated financial services environment, with working knowledge of operational resilience expectations and DORA, and direct experience producing evidence for regulators or auditors.

  • Experience running production platforms, not only building them, incident management, on-call, and service ownership.

  • Track record leading small, senior engineering teams while remaining technically hands-on.

  • Comfort operating within a centrally governed control environment, and the judgement to distinguish a genuine local regulatory requirement from a preference.

  • Work closely with UK platform, security, and product-engineering functions. This role influences the central control set through evidence and horizon scanning, and does not diverge from it unilaterally.

data.title: Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
data.description:
Build the security foundations behind cutting-edge construction technology

At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, our technology – and the security environment supporting it – is becoming increasingly sophisticated.

Our stack spans Kubernetes on Azure, mobile and embedded AR, REST APIs, real-time collaboration and AI-powered data pipelines. We already hold SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, but as our product, customers and use of AI continue to evolve, we now need dedicated security expertise within the business.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Security & Compliance Engineer to take ownership of security across XYZ Reality and help build a security capability that can scale with us.

The Role

This is a critical hire and an opportunity to become our first dedicated security specialist, with genuine ownership and influence across the business.

While we already have established compliance activity and SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, security responsibilities currently sit across different teams. We’re now looking for someone who can bring that together, identify where we need to strengthen our approach and provide dedicated technical security leadership as we scale.

This is first and foremost a technical security role. You’ll sit within Engineering and work directly alongside the teams building our technology, participating in architecture discussions, development workflows and technical decision-making rather than operating as a separate security function reviewing work after the fact.

You’ll take ownership of security architecture across our technology stack, embed shift-left security practices into how we build, strengthen our cloud and application security, and ensure we remain ahead of both established and emerging threats.

As our use of AI continues to develop, you’ll also help us understand and respond to new AI-related security risks and attack vectors, ensuring our security approach evolves alongside our technology.

Compliance remains an important part of the role. You’ll help strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 posture and support areas including GDPR, data residency and enterprise customer requirements. However, we’re looking for someone who brings strong hands-on security expertise first, alongside the governance and compliance knowledge needed to operate effectively across both areas.

You won’t simply inherit a security playbook, you’ll have the opportunity to help build one.

The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work closely with our Engineering, Product and wider business teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Take ownership of security architecture and technical security across XYZ Reality’s technology environment.

  • Assess our current security posture, identify vulnerabilities and control gaps, and develop pragmatic remediation plans.

  • Architect and strengthen security across our Azure cloud environment, including Kubernetes clusters, databases and data pipelines.

  • Own and improve areas including IAM, zero-trust networking, secrets management, RBAC, pod security and encryption.

  • Embed shift-left security into engineering workflows, integrating SAST, DAST, dependency scanning and SCA into our CI/CD pipelines.

  • Partner directly with Engineering and Product teams on architectural decisions, technical trade-offs and secure-by-design development.

  • Run threat-modelling exercises and support developers with secure coding practices across Node.js, React Native and C++ environments.

  • Own vulnerability management, including triage, risk prioritisation, remediation tracking and incident response where required.

  • Develop and improve the logging, monitoring and alerting capabilities needed to identify and respond to security threats.

  • Assess emerging threats, including those associated with AI-enabled products, tooling and new attack methodologies, and ensure our security approach continues to evolve.

  • Strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 controls, identifying gaps and improving implementation where needed.

  • Support compliance cycles including controls testing, evidence gathering and auditor coordination.

  • Support GDPR and data residency requirements across our infrastructure and data pipelines.

data.description:
Build the technology behind the teams transforming construction

At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, we’re not only evolving the technology our customers use, we’re also investing in the tools and applications that enable our own teams to operate effectively as we grow.

We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to take ownership of the internal applications, dashboards and AI-enabled tools that help power XYZ Reality behind the scenes.

The Role

This is a great opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building useful products, solving real business problems and owning what they create from idea through to production.

As XYZ has grown, teams across the business have increasingly developed applications, dashboards, automations and AI-enabled tools to solve problems and improve how they work. We now need an engineer who can bring technical ownership to this space – taking promising ideas and prototypes and turning them into secure, scalable and maintainable applications.

You’ll work directly with teams across XYZ to understand what they need, translate those requirements into technical solutions and build applications that people across the business will genuinely use.

Because these tools can interact with employee, user and potentially customer data, you’ll also ensure they are built and deployed properly, with security, maintainability and appropriate engineering standards considered from the outset.

This is a role with plenty of autonomy. You’ll own applications end-to-end, from architecture and data model through to UI, deployment, monitoring and ongoing iteration.

And when internal priorities allow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your Full Stack skills to our wider product engineering team and the technology behind XYZ Reality’s engineering-grade AR platform.

data.title: Senior PR Manager
data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

data.title: (Senior) B2B Operations Manager (all genders)
data.description:
Über die Rolle

Als B2B Operations Manager entwickelst du die Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsweisen unseres B2B-Bereichs. Du nutzt Daten, Automatisierung und KI, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und Abläufe skalierbar zu machen. So kann sich das Team stärker auf Kunden, Partnerschaften und Wachstum konzentrieren.

Unser CRM befindet sich im finalen Aufbau. Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung dafür, wie B2B-Prozesse im CRM abgebildet werden: Du erkennst Engpässe in der Datenpflege und den Workflows, formulierst Anforderungen an Struktur und Automatisierung und setzt neue Abläufe gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams um - von der Abbildung von Lead-Qualifizierung und Onboarding über Pricing- und Konditionslogik bis zu Partnerkommunikation und Shop-Prozessen.


Deine Aufgaben

B2B-Prozesse & Operations (ca. 60%)

  • Du übernimmst 0-to-1-Ownership für unsere B2B-Prozesse, von der Lead-Qualifizierung über das Onboarding bis zur laufenden Partnerbetreuung. Wo heute kein sauberer Ablauf existiert, baust du einen.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu CRM und Automation: Du verstehst die Datenflüsse, erkennst Engpässe und formulierst klare Anforderungen, die Data & AI und IT technisch umsetzen. CRM-Hygiene ist für dich die Grundlage jeder verlässlichen Auswertung.
  • Du verbindest Sales, Supply Chain, Finance und Product zu reibungslosen Abläufen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran.
  • Du definierst und trackst zentrale KPIs (Conversion Rate, Pipeline-Geschwindigkeit, Lead-Qualität, Customer Value) und baust Reporting, das dem Team echte Steuerungsintelligenz gibt, keine Zahlenfriedhöfe.
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert: Du machst Best Practices zu Playbooks und SOPs und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Team wirklich genutzt werden.
Operatives Enabling (ca. 40%)
  • Du verantwortest B2B-Newsletter und Partner-Kommunikation: Du bringst die richtigen Aktionen zu den richtigen Partnergruppen und wertest ihre Wirkung aus (Open Rate, CTR, Conversion).
  • Du entwickelst unsere Pricing- und Konditionenlogik mit und pflegst sie sauber in Shop und CRM: kommerziell durchdacht, konsistent, nachvollziehbar.
  • Du betreust unseren B2B-Shop und den Education-Shop: Produktzugänge, Kollektionen, Bundles, kleinere Anpassungen, und du begleitest die Shop-Migration.
  • Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast 3-4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Sales-Organisation, Commercial/Sales Operations, Strategieberatung oder einem Scale-up gesammelt. Ein Hintergrund in einer Strategieberatung oder Business Development ist ein Pluspunkt.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit HubSpot und bewegst dich sicher in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Workflows.
  • Du bist ein hands-on Generalist: Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, setzt selbst um statt zu delegieren, und dir ist keine Aufgabe zu klein. 
  • Du hast bereits komplexe, bereichsübergreifende Projekte eigenständig geführt - von Scoping und Business Case über die Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Team (SOPs, Playbooks, Trainings).
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du erkennst Chancen, priorisierst nach Wirkung und Skalierbarkeit und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du arbeitest stark analytisch: Du bewegst dich sicher in großen Datenmengen und Spreadsheets und ziehst daraus klare, umsetzbare Schlüsse.
  • Du hast eine hohe KI- und Datenaffinität: Du hast KI-Tools bereits praktisch in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt und möchtest sie zu einem festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise machen. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und lernst schnell. 
  • Du strukturierst fachliche Bedarfe und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Anforderungen an Prozesse, Daten und Systeme. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und zielgruppengerecht innerhalb des Unternehmens.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.


Was uns wichtig ist

  • Stapelstein ist für dich kein Job - sondern eine Mission, hinter der du wirklich stehst. 
  • Für dich ist ein respektvoller, empathischer Umgang keine Checkbox - sondern die Basis, auf der gute Zusammenarbeit entsteht.
  • Herausforderungen bremsen dich nicht - sie machen dich neugierig. 
  • Du denkst kreativ und unternehmerisch - du findest Wege, wo andere Hindernisse sehen, und machst dich in deinen Rollen wirklich wirkungsvoll. 
  • Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung und triffst Entscheidungen mit Überzeugung - ohne dass jemand fragen muss. 
  • Du brauchst keine Struktur von außen - du schaffst sie dir selbst. 
  • Du nutzt KI nicht, weil es alle tun - sondern weil du verstanden hast, dass es die Art, wie wir arbeiten, grundlegend verändert.


Was wir bieten

  • Der Start ist jederzeit möglich. 
  • Ein marktübliches, faires Gehaltspaket. 
  • Remote-first - in Deutschland und zeitweise auch aus dem Ausland. 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer gemeinsamen Kernzeit von 9-12 Uhr. 
  • Überstunden werden vollständig durch Freizeitausgleich ausgeglichen. 
  • Vollzeit bedeutet bei uns 36 Stunden pro Woche - für mehr Fokus und mehr Lebenszeit. Ergänzt wird das durch 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr. 
  • Monatliche Team-Meet-ups in Stuttgart oder Berlin. Zeit, um gemeinsam im selben Raum zu arbeiten, Projekte voranzubringen und sich persönlich auszutauschen. 
  • Zwei inspirierende Offsites pro Jahr, weil echtes Teamgefühl trotz Remote-first seinen Raum braucht. 
  • Flexible Benefits wie Einkaufsbudget, Mobilitätszuschuss oder Urban Sports - nach bestandener Probezeit.
